Docs.summary: Marks a native method to use faster Java Native Interface (JNI) transitions.

remarks.para: While a fast native method executes, garbage collection cannot suspend its thread and may be blocked. Do not use this attribute on long-running methods or methods that perform significant I/O or acquire native locks that can be held for a long time. This attribute has no effect on non-native methods.

This optimization is a CTS-tested public API starting in Android 14. For maximum compatibility, avoid calling fast native methods on Android 13 and earlier. Dynamic JNI linking works only on Android 12 and later; methods used on Android 8 through Android 11 must be explicitly registered with JNI RegisterNatives. The attribute is ignored on Android 7 and earlier.
